image_description: A highly ornate, baroque-style church interior featuring a grand altar complex. The central focus is a raised altar table draped in red cloth with gold embroidery, positioned beneath an elaborate architectural structure (reredos) featuring columns, niches with statues, and religious paintings. The scene includes floral arrangements in the foreground and intricate gilded details throughout.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the object as an altar and distinguish it from general furniture or shrines.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex multi-layered reredos and ensure no melting between columns and background.
To check for edge bleeding between the altar cloth and the stone base, ensuring distinct material boundaries.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the gilding and marble veins which are common failure points in AI generation.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between the red altar cloth and the stone base
Structural logic of the columns supporting the upper arches
Consistency of marble veining patterns across different surfaces
Legibility and structure of any inscriptions on the altar front
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the floral arrangements and the altar steps; AI often blends organic shapes into rigid geometry here. Verify if the 'statues' in the niches have coherent anatomy or if they suffer from melting/fusion artifacts.
